rules.event_id: random per event; not derived from a person or device
rules.occurred_at: rounded to the minimum precision approved for funnel ordering
rules.test_run_id: identifies the approved test window, not a participant
rules.page_key: one of homepage, shop, our_story, carob_story, stockists, faq, review_hub
rules.viewport_family: phone, tablet, or desktop; never exact dimensions
rules.browser_family: coarse family only; never full user agent

optional_funnel_link.rule: random first-party token limited to one approved test session; no account, cross-site use, identity binding or reuse; activate only after privacy approval

events.name: page_section_view
events.purpose: identify which meaningful page sections were reached

events.name: navigation_click
events.purpose: test whether visitors can move through the six-page experience

events.name: cta_product_interest_click
events.purpose: measure evidence-backed product exploration without inferring purchase intent

events.name: mock_cart_step
events.purpose: test the explicitly mocked cart journey; never create an order

events.name: feedback_open
events.purpose: measure entry into the approved review feedback flow

events.name: feedback_submit
events.purpose: record a separately approved test submission without copying comment text into analytics

events.name: feedback_abandon
events.purpose: identify friction without capturing typed text

events.name: technical_failure
events.purpose: identify broken journeys and rendering defects

activation_gates: Nate approves exact artifact, participants, window, invitation, access and event subset
privacy/security owner approves notice, consent disposition, endpoint, access, retention and deletion
internal synthetic dry run passes with test_data=true
event validation proves no prohibited property, cookie, third-party request or production mixing
rollback and immediate deactivation are tested
